# total_returned: sum of returns across all bets (USD). On a winning bet
n_bets: return = stake + profit_at_odds; on a loss

subset: # total_profit: total_returned - total_invested. Negative = lost money
# roi_pct: total_profit / total_invested. The single most important number
# avg_moneyline_taken: mean American odds across all bets placed - lets you sanity-check break-even expectations
# break_even_win_pct: minimum win% needed at the avg odds taken to break even. Compare with win_pct
